items.title: Fix local-parity defects that give wrong answers
items.problem: Several local behaviors differ silently from Fabric or from the app's own UI: a notebook using variableLibrary is flagged Fabric-only, %%sql MERGE cells report ok, notebookutils.session is missing though documented, insertInto defaults to errorifexists, and scheduled runs execute frozen cells that UI runs skip.
items.capability: Each defect fixed or turned into an explicit, visible refusal, with a regression test per defect.
evidence: notebook.py %%sql MERGE path prints a note and returns ok
notebookutils_local.py docstring names session; attribute absent
local_schedules.py runs all cells; notebook.js skips frozen cells (inference from code reading)
acceptance: compute_check reports a variableLibrary notebook as able to run on the PC

Scheduled and UI runs treat frozen cells the same way, covered by one test
items.mandatory_reason: Wrong-answer defects in local execution undermine the core promise and the rule that local results are never claimed equivalent without proof.
